en: 1 Chronicles 9

p.src: 1  So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

ja: こうして全イスラエルが
に記された。見よ、 それらはイスラエルの
されている。ユダの民は、その
信のゆえにバビロンへ
囚として連れ去られた。
en: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.
u.src: 1  So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

ja: 9:1 「見よ」はヘブル語「הִנֵּה」に由来し、「見なさい」「注目しなさい」「よく見よ」などの意味を持つ間投詞である。
en: 9:1 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 2  Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

ja: んだ住民は、イスラエル
、および宮のしもべたちであった。
en: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.
u.src: 2  Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

en: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.
